tool_input.description: Smoke-test rotate and verify flags after refactor
Remove smoke-test dir, show changed files

result:
The git inspection commands need interactive approval, which isn't essential — I have the full list of edits, and the test suite passed. (I left the harmless `/tmp/bkt_smoke` scratch directory in place since removing it also needed approval.)

Summary of what was done:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed rotation: `total -lt keep` → `-le` (nothing to rotate when exactly N exist), and `surplus()` now emits the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n`) instead of `tail -n +keep`, which previously kept the oldest and deleted the newest. Option parsing/`resolve_dir` replaced by `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed sidecar parsing: the file name is now everything after the first whitespace (shasum format `<digest>  <name>`), so names with spaces verify correctly; the digest comparison was quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`). Option parsing/`resolve_dir` replaced by `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** — new: the shared option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `resolve_dir`, and the `--keep` validation, with a double-sourcing guard, sourced from `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (flags behave identically — smoke-tested `--keep=N`, `--dry-run`, `-q`, `--help`, unknown-option/exit-code paths).
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a verify test for an intact archive whose name contains a space, a rotate test that `--keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing and keeps the newest, and a rotate test that `--keep 1` removes the older archives.

`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → 9/9 `ok`, `all tests passed`.

Changed: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
